note: One sentence per claim of absence, written before the first ranking run and never reworded after seeing results. Each sentence is the requirement that would contradict the claim if NASA-STD-3001 contained it, in our words, not NASA's. The model ranks the 543 requirements by closeness in meaning to this sentence; the keyword count stays the claim.

queries.query: Electronic equipment shall meet electromagnetic interference and electromagnetic compatibility (EMI/EMC) limits.
Materials in prolonged contact with a crewmember's skin shall be tested for biocompatibility, including skin irritation and cytotoxicity.
Each crewmember shall wear a body-worn biosensor that continuously monitors physiological signals such as heart rate.
A battery-powered wearable device shall operate for a minimum number of hours on one charge.
The system shall store recorded monitoring data with a minimum storage capacity, retention period and log duration.
The system shall alert the crew in flight when a crewmember's vital sign crosses a specified numeric threshold.
